lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are organized into roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. A primary column of four large, distinct spots is visible followed by a posterior column containing three visible nodes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular blobs, forming a grid-like structure where blobs serve as high-intensity anchor points within the vertical striations.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A clear horizontal linear feature is present on the upper lateral flank, defined by a sharp luminance increase on the dorsal edge and a corresponding shadow gradient on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density population of small-diameter high-luminance spots, which are significantly smaller and more tightly packed than the spots on the primary lateral flank.
